name: Sprout: AI Finance & Cash Flow
description: Official hosted MCP server for Sprout by MindCrafters LLC. Read-only tools over the user's own connected US and Canadian bank and card accounts (via Plaid): balances, data health, cash flow, spending by category or merchant, period totals and comparisons, transaction search, recurring charges, and unusual or duplicate charges. update_settings only saves the default reporting period; it cannot move money. Open sign-up with Google, Apple or email; requires Sprout Plus (US$9.99/week or US$99.99/year, 3-day free trial if eligible). Authenticates with OAuth 2.1 (WorkOS AuthKit, Client ID Metadata Documents).
author: MindCrafters LLC
